Priya (Partnerships): AuroraModels signed the onboarding LOI. Two quick asks from them: permit distribution to appliance OEMs and permission to ship 4-bit builds. Need alignment on distribution controls and manifest metadata. @Noah @Lina
Noah (Legal): High level: fine with OEM distribution if we (1) require named OEMs in Appendix B, and (2) require a redistribution addendum. For 4-bit, check export control but legally treat it like a derived artifact.
Lina (Product): Manifest must include `id`, `version`, `artifact_types` (fp32,int8,q4), `provenance_url`, `attribution_text`. Also a `derived_weights` flag so UI can surface a warning.
Omar (Eng): We'll build fp32 + int8 + q4 artifacts. Q4 will be `q4_k` quant method. We'll sign packages and include `sha256` and `build_date` in provenance. Note: q4 has slight quality variance; we'll put a short caveat in the model-card.
Becca (Solutions): For SIs: recommend we pilot with EchoSys for 4 weeks. Need a tested appliance image and a small terraform example. I'll coordinate customer validation.
Priya (Partnerships): Proposed schedule: legal clause by Thu, artifacts + checksums Wed, manifest schema Wed, SI pilot start in two weeks, announcement after pilot. Any blockers?
Noah (Legal): One question for AuroraModels: do they want co-branding on OEM SKUs? If yes, we need trademark usage terms. Also will draft redistribution clause: named OEMs + addendum + revocation right for compliance.
Lina (Product): I'll add UI copy: "Warning: derived/quantized artifacts may have reduced fidelity for some prompts." Also require `export_classification` field in manifest as Omar suggested.
Omar (Eng): Packaging: signed tar.gz with `manifest.json` and `provenance.json`. Example manifest keys: `name`, `version`, `sha256`, `precision`, `quant_method`, `framework`, `export_classification`.
Priya (Partnerships): Action items: Noah: legal + redistribution addendum by Thu; Omar: build artifacts + provenance by Wed; Lina: finalize manifest + warning copy by Wed; Becca: EchoSys pilot outreach by EOD.
